title: One-Step Generative Surrogate Models via Block-Triangular Joint Drifting
abstract: arXiv:2609.26435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Drifting provides a direct route to one-step generative models, but applying it directly to stochastic transition modeling requires multiple samples of the next state conditioned on the same current state. Standard trajectory data, however, typically provide only one realized next state for each observed current state and therefore do not provide an empirical approximation of the corresponding conditional distribution over possible next states. We introduce block-triangular joint drifting, which instead applies a projected drift field to the empirically accessible joint distribution of consecutive states. Importantly, the block-triangular architecture preserves the current-state marginal while making its second component a direct sampler of the conditional distribution of possible next states. The resulting surrogate generates stochastic trajectories with one model evaluation per time step, without auxiliary generative steps between time

translated_title: 基于块三角联合漂移的单步生成式代理模型
translated_abstract: 漂移为构建单步生成式模型提供了一条直接途径，但将其直接应用于随机转移建模时，需要在相同当前状态下对可能的下一状态进行多次采样。然而，标准轨迹数据通常只为每个观测到的当前状态提供一个已实现的下一状态，因而无法为相应的下一状态条件分布提供经验近似。我们提出了块三角联合漂移方法，该方法将投影漂移场应用于可经验获取的连续状态联合分布。重要的是，块三角结构在保持当前状态边缘分布的同时，使其第二个分量成为下一状态条件分布的直接采样器。由此得到的代理模型在每个时间步仅需一次模型评估即可生成随机轨迹，无需在时间步之间进行额外的生成步骤。
tldr: 该论文提出块三角联合漂移方法，通过对连续状态的联合分布施加投影漂移场，使生成式代理模型在每个时间步仅需一次模型评估即可直接采样生成随机轨迹。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes block-triangular joint drifting, which applies a projected drift field to the empirically accessible joint distribution of consecutive states, enabling generative surrogate models to sample stochastic trajectories with only one model evaluation per time step.
